description: The RETRY phrase (ISO 14.7.9; RETRY n TIMES | FOR n SECONDS | FOREVER on OPEN/READ/WRITE/REWRITE/DELETE) - an exhausted retry lands the CONFLICT'S OWN 9.1.13 status: n TIMES loops the lock check then reports 51/61/62 (GR1; a zero or negative n makes no further attempt, GR4a), FOR n SECONDS makes none because GR2 clamps the timeout period to this implementation's maximum meaningful value of zero (A.1 item 166) and reports the same, and FOREVER alone reports the 9.1.13.8 item 2 deadlock 52 - and only for a RECORD conflict, since 9.1.13.9 defines no deadlock value. A conflict held OUTSIDE the run unit (another run unit's handle) can clear: TIMES waits 100 ms before each re-attempt against it (A.1 item 165) and FOREVER keeps attempting until the operation completes (GR3). A COBOL-2002 introduction; 0900 below 2002. THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): ANSI X3.23-1985 has neither file sharing nor record locking, and RETRY is no 1985 reserved word (§1985:IV.8 runs RESET, RETURN: its rows '| PERFORM | RESET | SUB-QUEUE-3 | WORKING-STORAGE |' and '| PF | RETURN | SUBTRACT | WRITE |'); §2002:14.6.8 introduces the phrase ('The RETRY phrase is specified in an input-output statement to indicate whether the MSCS is to continue to attempt to obtain access in the event that a file or record is locked'; §2002:14.6.8.2 GR3: 'If the FOREVER phrase is specified, the MSCS shall attempt to gain access to a locked resource until the input-output operation has been completed'), §2002:F.1 item 6 lists RETRY among the words of 'Reserved words. The following reserved words have been added', and §2002:F.2 states the facilities it serves, its items 52 ('File sharing provides a cooperative environment that allows the user to permit or deny access by concurrent file connectors to a physical file') and 111 ('Record locking allows control of record access for shared files'). §2014:14.7.8 carries the phrase and §2014:14.7.8.2 GR3 its FOREVER rule, so 2014 = 2023.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. ROWRT.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT F ASSIGN TO "f.dat" ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD F.
       01 R PIC X(8).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           OPEN INPUT RETRY 3 TIMES F.
           CLOSE F.
           STOP RUN.
